source_template.quote: A vehicle shall not be turned so as to proceed in the opposite direction upon any curve, or upon the approach to or near the crest of a grade, where such vehicle cannot be seen by the driver of any other vehicle approaching from either direction within 500 feet.

source_required_observations.note: turning to proceed in the opposite direction
the approach to or near the crest of a grade
the distance within which the vehicle can be seen, against the 500-foot requirement
a vehicle approaching from either direction
the crest the subject approaches or is near

source_residue: the 500-foot visibility is a sight-line construction: as good as st.sight_distance on the source, and it must be computed in both directions

activation.condition: The vehicle is upon a curve, or upon the approach to or near the crest of a grade, and cannot be seen within 500 feet by an approaching driver from at least one of the two directions. Evaluate visibility geometrically in both directions at the maneuver location. The directional numeric conditions are alternatives, not cumulative prerequisites. Turning to proceed in the opposite direction is the prohibited behavior, not an activation prerequisite.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Preserve the meaning of approach and near as unresolved. Observe the vehicle's position and trajectory relative to the grade profile and crest; do not assign a distance cutoff.
